Answer: C
Reason: The PA chest X-ray (Figure 1a) clearly shows two distinct nodules indicated by blue arrows: one in the right middle lobe silhouetting the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding, combined with the mention of a mosaic attenuation pattern (typically seen on CT but associated with this diagnosis), is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH). Options A, B, D, E, and F describe patterns (single large nodule, diffuse miliary, effusions, perihilar infiltrates, cavitary lesions) that do not match the visual evidence of two discrete nodules.
